name: Alta
registry_notes: Town of Alta (~380 pop); 4 at-large council + VOTING mayor (max tally 5); minutes via Utah PMN

caveats.text: Town of Alta (~380 pop) is SPARSE BY DESIGN (~12 meetings/yr): 4 at-large + VOTING mayor (max tally 5). The PC is 100% tally-only and council naming is irregular — per-member analytics rest on a small named subset.

Alta's 2021 municipal results were privacy-suppressed by the county, and the 2025 municipal election was CANCELLED under Utah Code 20A-1-206 (uncontested) — absence of 2025 contest rows is the election not happening, not a gap.
